combinations.evidence_quote: DI‐D/FC5‐DIE3IR had no effect in reducing the time mice spend in pain behaviors (311.68 ± 58.57 s, n = 6; Figure 4C,D), suggesting that the binding of DI‐D to the recombinant protein FC5‐DIE3IR prevents the binding of VHH DI‐D to the Nav1.7 channel.
